_說明: G3 B 版童聲方案：ElevenLabs 聲線設計（text-to-voice/design）。description 為英文描述（≥100 字元）；preview_lines 是該角色劇本台詞（套替身字後串成試聽文字，需 ≥100 字元）。試聽 3 個，依轉寫正確率與 F0 選一個儲存。

xiaoqing.description: A nine-year-old girl from Taiwan speaking natural Taiwan Mandarin (Taiwanese Guoyu accent, soft retroflex, not a Beijing accent). Calm, observant and sensible; speaks in short, confident sentences at a medium pace. Bright, clear, mid-high child voice, warm and friendly, not squeaky, not baby talk, not whispering, not exaggerated. Clean close-microphone studio recording with no background noise, no music and no reverb.

xiaoyu.description: A nine-year-old boy from Taiwan speaking natural Taiwan Mandarin (Taiwanese Guoyu accent, not a Beijing accent). Curious, lively and quick, with a friendly, energetic tone; his voice has not broken yet, a clear child voice in the middle range, a little lower and rounder than a girl's. Not squeaky, not cartoonish, not baby talk. Clean close-microphone studio recording with no background noise, no music and no reverb.

zhezhe.description: A playful origami paper cat, the cheerful host character of a children's paper puppet theater in Taiwan, speaking natural Taiwan Mandarin (Taiwanese Guoyu accent, not a Beijing accent). Bright, light, youthful and gender-neutral voice, the highest-pitched voice in the cast, lively with a slight upward lilt at the end of sentences, friendly and warm but never shrill, squeaky or babyish. Clean close-microphone studio recording with no background noise, no music and no reverb.
